notes: Three Smith College university-layer documents (students page, faculty/staff page, AIB faculty page); both coders marked all three delegates. Main disagreements on matched units: (1) modality, mostly should vs informs/must on advisory or announcement lines (data protection kept should, resource announcements informs); (2) phase for syllabus-communication lines (before-course vs course-start; resolved to course-start per the codebook phase definition); (3) actor for statements of fact or college commitments (all/admin chosen over instructor/student); (4) unit_stance on rationale and condition lines (rationale neutral, disclosure conditions permit); (5) policy_type in four cases: bias of AI detectors (P53 over P39), learn-about-detectors (P102 over P63), benefits-and-development video (P87 over UNCOVERED) and employee training (P63 over P70). Coder B's student-voice line was moved from a stretched P32 to UNCOVERED to match the students-page voice unit. Coder B folded detector unreliability and bias into one unit; coder A split them and both were kept. Only-A units (6, all on the AIB page: inform-the-student step, reporting form, detector unreliability, case records, discussion timing, recognizing AI papers by lack of voice) and only-B units (3: committee-scope statement, per-assignment guidelines, student's voice) were all real policy text and kept.
